    Exam reminders

    Pick an exam and how early you want a reminder. Copy the prompt into your own ChatGPT chat, then check that ChatGPT confirms the time. This site does not create tasks or send notifications.

    How your study data is stored

    Guest progress and notes stay in this browser. If you sign in, the site uses your ChatGPT sign-in ID to sync your progress, notes, quiz results and settings. A copy also stays in this browser after sign-out. To remove that local copy, clear this site's browser data; that does not erase your synced copy.

    Downloaded backups are readable files that may contain your notes. YouTube serves the video thumbnails and optional player. The planner does not send your notes to YouTube or ChatGPT chats, and reminder prompts are only copied when you choose. There is no in-app control to delete synced data.
